newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends softer after dull session.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends softer after dull session.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar ended softer at around C$1.3338 (US$0.7497) from Friday's close at C$1.3313 (US$0.7511) after a dull session * Canada unit weakened along with softer U.S. currency, but volumes were light due to Remembrance Day holiday for government, banks * Quiet overnight trading seen with Canada unit holding between C$1.3325 and C$1.3350.
The Canadian unit is expected to trade quietly overnight between C$1.3325 and C$1.3350.
Canadian bonds closed early on Monday, ending flat as investors look ahead to U.S. economic data and a U.S. Federal Reserve Open Market Committee meeting on Wednesday.
Bank of Canada Governor Gordon Thiessen will deliver his semi-annual monetary policy report on Thursday.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar fell to 1.1188 marks from Friday's close at 1.1294 markets and slipped to 83.22 yen from 83.99 yen on Friday.
